title: Abstract Algebra I
description:
These are my lectures for Math 421 in Fall 2016. Our text is Contemporary Abstract Algebra by Joseph Gallian, 5th ed.

I have a bunch of homeworks, tests and some solutions posted at:
http://www.supermath.info/AbstractAlgebra.html
